title: pr-pane 0.6.1: reject unknown /prs arguments
summary: /prs with an unknown argument opened the pane instead of saying so.
description: Jeremy typed '/prs layout close' and got 'Pull requests pane opened': every argument not handled earlier fell through to the open path.

acceptanceCriteria.text: /prs with an argument it does not know answers with the argument and a pointer to /prs help, and neither opens nor closes the pane
Every documented form still works, and a test covers the unknown case

implementationNotes: Evidence: pane test '/prs answers an unknown argument without opening or closing the pane': 'layout close' and 'opne' get the message with the pane neither opened nor closed, and refresh, show and bare /prs still work. The other documented forms (help, log, layout, autoOpen, diagram) are covered by their existing tests, all passing. Removing the guard fails 2 tests.
finalSummary: Shipped in pr-pane 0.6.1 (PR #11, tag v0.6.1). /prs with an unknown argument now answers '/prs doesn't know "<arg>". Run /prs help for the commands.' and leaves the pane alone, instead of opening it. Found when Jeremy ran '/prs layout close'. Verified by a pane test, a mutation check, tsc, validate --strict and CI.
